title: Book Three · Chapter 137: Jun on the Field
story:
The following Sunday, Ronan takes his football to the park with Kai.

Two boys are already near the field. One turns at the sound of Kai's voice.

It is Jun.

For a moment, Ronan sees a much younger boy beside a pile of school papers. Then Jun lifts a hand, and Ronan lifts his own.

“Still that ball?” Jun asks.

“A different one. From my sixteenth birthday.”

Ronan turns it in his hands. The short white mark is beside the seam.

“Kai helped buy it.”

He introduces them. Jun introduces his own friend, then points to the empty grass.

“Four?”

Kai looks at Ronan. “Better than two.”

They put their bags near the side and choose the goals. Jun stands with Kai. Ronan takes the other side with Jun's friend.

The game is quick and untidy. Jun sends a pass too far, and Kai has to chase it. Ronan laughs until his next kick goes in exactly the same direction.

“There is a very good player over there,” Jun says.

He points to the empty corner.

Ronan runs to fetch the ball. When he comes back, all three are still smiling.

Jun's friend asks him for a shorter pass.

“Not out there,” he says, pointing toward the corner.

“I noticed.”

Ronan sends the next one closer. The boy stops it, looks up, and gives it back.

For a few minutes, they learn each other's pace. The boy turns quickly near the goal. Ronan needs more room to stop.

Jun calls something from the other side. Ronan answers before he thinks, and both laugh.

Kai misses part of the joke.

“What?”

“An old game,” Jun says.

Ronan shows Kai the little move with his foot. Jun tries to stop him. This time, he does.

“Very old,” Ronan says.

Kai takes the ball and gives the move a try himself. It is a little different with his longer step.

Jun's friend runs to meet him. Ronan goes back toward the goal. There are four players here now, and he needs to watch all three of the others.

They change sides after a while. Ronan and Jun play together for the next game.

Jun knows one of his old moves. He runs to the side before Ronan makes the pass.

The ball reaches his foot. He turns and sends it into the little goal.

“Still that move,” he says.

“It works sometimes.”

At the end, they sit beside the bags. Kai drinks and asks Jun about his friend. The two start talking about another field across town.

Ronan rolls the ball between his shoes. A piece of grass sticks to the white mark. He pulls it off.

“Leo always wanted the ball,” Jun says.

Ronan nods. “And he told me that very loudly.”

Jun laughs.

“Still in the other city?”

“Yes. We write.”

Ronan tells him one small story about Leo's missed bus stop. Jun smiles and looks toward Kai, who is explaining the other field with both hands.

Soon Jun and his friend need to leave. Ronan picks up the ball while they collect their bags.

“Good game,” Jun says.

“Good to see you.”

They lift hands at the path. Then Jun goes with his friend, and Kai comes back for his bottle.

Ronan gives him a short pass before they leave. This one stays near the bags, and Kai stops it with his shoe.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

untidy＝乱些、不整齐的；direction＝方向；seam＝接缝；introduce＝介绍认识。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样让Kai和Jun认识？这次见面实际做了什么？
2. Jun是否又成了共同项目搭档？他离开时与谁同行？

## 读句子

**They change sides after a while.**

拆开看：They / change sides / after a while.

他们／换了分组或场上搭配／过了一阵之后。
